summary: The range f26965d..c0a26d7 changes only error_line_of in review-run.sh and judge-run.sh, adds the 4.13aa tests, and records the plan entries. Both runner hunks are identical: a scan that exits 2 fails closed to the fixed text, and the decoded error-event text is scanned too. The probe record fields (write_probe_record, review-run.sh:909), the state values (reachable, region-blocked, unreachable, complete, open, wait), and the probe and night driver parsing (probe-4.10.sh:135-143, night-4.11.sh:62-63 and 223) are unchanged. All ten test suites pass.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] review-c: the process-table guard ADV-R-12 (harness/model-guide-tests/adversarial-p4-runner.test.ts:916, liveFakeOpencode at :474) greps the whole process table, so a fake-opencode child of a concurrent session fails the file. It failed once today with another session's child (process started 11:19:33, after my judge-run ended 11:19:10) and passed 14/14 in a quiet window. Rationale: the guard cannot tell its own children from another session's. backlog 4.14.
